messages.subject: Shiny Server Binary for Ubuntu 15
parts: The webpage https://www.rstudio.com/products/shiny/download-server/ states that the binary is suitable for "for Ubuntu 12.04 (or later)" but because of the switch to using upstart, it doesn't work. I notice there is a version 1.4.0 of the server in GitHub since April, which is compatible with the latest Ubuntu version. Will this be available from the RStudio website soon ? I installed the server from source, but it would be convenient to have a DEB file available.
